newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Semiconductor forms investment firm.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Semiconductor forms investment firm.

text.p: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd, the island's biggest semiconductor maker, said on Tuesday that it had signed a contract to set up a US$20 million venture capital firm to invest in high-tech companies.

InveStar Capital Inc, a domestic venture management firm, would be responsible for operations of the new firm InveStar Seminconductor Development Fund Inc, to be owned 97.1 percent by Taiwan Semiconductor, the company said in a statement.
Taiwan Semiconductor has set a 1996 net profit target of T$22.07 billion on sales of T$41.97 billion.
